source.description: DIL-style source, up to 120 KiB. Example: {@body const [rate, setRate] = DIL.useState(5); const total = 1000 * (1 + rate / 100); } <Stack><Slider label="Rate (%)" value={rate} onChange={setRate} min={0} max={20} step={0.5}/><Metric label="After one year" value={DIL.format(total, 'currency', 'USD')}/><Button onClick={() => DIL.sendMessage(`Explain the result at ${rate}%`)}>Explain this result</Button></Stack>. Declare state once in the leading body with const [name, setName] = DIL.useState(JSON initial). Setters accept values or updater functions. Support const/let, functions/arrows, local variables, return, if, arithmetic/comparisons/ternaries, template strings, optional property access, arrays/objects, destructuring, spread, map/filter/find/some/every/reduce, slice/join/includes, string methods and number.toFixed(0–8). No loops, imports, classes, async, regular expressions, globals or DOM. Math supports abs/min/max/round/floor/ceil/sqrt/pow/sin/cos/tan/atan2/log/exp/sign/PI/E. DIL.range(start,end,step=1) excludes end; DIL.format(number,style='number',currency='USD') supports number/percent/currency. Functions can return JSX components. Use key on mapped components. JSX text and expressions form the document; wrap prose in Text (strong/em/code/br supported). Layouts: Stack/Row/Flow(gap='none|small|medium|large',align='start|center|end|stretch'), Grid(columns=1–4,gap), Card(title?,gap). Text/Caption/Heading(level=1–3)/Badge(tone?) take children; Divider. Metric(label,value,detail?), Progress(label,value,max=100), Disclosure(title,open?). Controls: Input(label,value,onChange,inputType='text|number|date',placeholder?,required?,disabled?,invalid?), TextArea(same without inputType), Slider(label,value,onChange,min,max,step=1,disabled?), Checkbox(label,checked,onChange,required?,disabled?), Select(label,value,onChange,options=[{label,value}],required?,disabled?), Radio/Segmented(label,value,onChange,options,disabled?). onChange receives the new value, not a DOM event. Button(label? or children,onClick,variant='primary|secondary',disabled?). Form(label,onSubmit) contains controls and supplies a submit button. DIL.sendMessage(text) only in Button.onClick or Form.onSubmit; DIL.copy(text) in user events. Chart(chartType='bar|line|area|scatter|pie|donut',points=[{label,value,x?}] OR series=[{id,label,chartType?,points}],title?,xLabel?,yLabel?,stacked?). Table(columns=[{key,label}],rows=[[cells]],title?). Custom diagrams: svg(viewBox,label,width?,height?) with g,path,circle,ellipse,rect,line,polyline,polygon,text,tspan,title,desc,defs,marker,linearGradient,radialGradient,stop,clipPath and standard geometry/paint attributes. SVG references must be local url(#id). Paint accepts semantic accent/text/muted/surface/border/success/warning/danger/info, currentColor, none, transparent, hex or rgb/hsl values; prefer semantic colors for theme adaptation. No style, arbitrary HTML, external resources, script, foreignObject, or SVG event handlers. Limits: 4096 syntax nodes, 512 rendered components, 200 items per collection, 30,000 evaluation steps, 16 KiB state. Put source last. Nested complete components and incoming text preview before outer JSX closes. Final source must parse completely.
